"""
Project Title: Mixture-of-Experts CNN for CIFAR-10 Classification (ai-ml-ds-MoECIFAR2025)
File Name: mixture_of_experts_cifar10.py

Short Description:
Implements a Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE) CNN in Keras for CIFAR‑10.
A gating network assigns each input to a weighted combination of multiple expert CNN branches.
Experts and gate are trained end‑to‑end, enabling dynamic routing and specialization.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras.datasets import cifar10  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
BATCH_SIZE: int = 128
EPOCHS: int = 50
LR: float = 1e-3
NUM_EXPERTS: int = 4
NUM_CLASSES: int = 10
INPUT_SHAPE: tuple = (32, 32, 3)
LOG_DIR: str = "./moe_logs/" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Data Loading
# ----------------------------
(x_train: np.ndarray, y_train: np.ndarray), (x_test: np.ndarray, y_test: np.ndarray) = cifar10.load_data()
x_train = x_train.astype("float32")/255.0; x_test = x_test.astype("float32")/255.0
y_train = tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(y_train, NUM_CLASSES)
y_test  = tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(y_test, NUM_CLASSES)

# ----------------------------
# 3. Expert CNN Definition
# ----------------------------
def build_expert(name: str) -> Model:
    inp = Input(shape=INPUT_SHAPE, name=f"{name}_in")
    x = layers.Conv2D(32,3,padding="same",activation="relu")(inp)
    x = layers.MaxPool2D()(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(64,3,padding="same",activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.MaxPool2D()(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(128,3,padding="same",activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D()(x)
    out = layers.Dense(NUM_CLASSES, activation=None, name=f"{name}_out")(x)
    return Model(inp, out, name=name)

experts = [build_expert(f"expert_{i}") for i in range(NUM_EXPERTS)]

# ----------------------------
# 4. Gating Network Definition
# ----------------------------
def build_gate() -> Model:
    inp = Input(shape=INPUT_SHAPE, name="gate_in")
    x = layers.Conv2D(16,3,padding="same",activation="relu")(inp)
    x = layers.MaxPool2D()(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(32,3,padding="same",activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D()(x)
    x = layers.Dense(64, activation="relu")(x)
    gate_out = layers.Dense(NUM_EXPERTS, activation="softmax", name="gate_out")(x)
    return Model(inp, gate_out, name="gate")

gate = build_gate()

# ----------------------------
# 5. Mixture-of-Experts Model
# ----------------------------
inp = Input(shape=INPUT_SHAPE, name="input")
# Expert logits
expert_logits = [expert(inp) for expert in experts]  # list of (batch,NUM_CLASSES)
# Gate weights
gate_w: tf.Tensor = gate(inp)                       # shape (batch,NUM_EXPERTS)
# Stack expert logits: shape (batch, EXPERTS, NUM_CLASSES)
stack = layers.Stack()(expert_logits)                # custom: use tf.stack
stack = tf.stack(expert_logits, axis=1)              # builtin
# Expand gate to align
gate_w_exp = tf.expand_dims(gate_w, -1)              # (batch,EXPERTS,1)
# Weighted sum
moe_logits = tf.reduce_sum(stack * gate_w_exp, axis=1)  # (batch,NUM_CLASSES)
out = layers.Activation("softmax", name="moe_out")(moe_logits)
model = Model(inputs=inp, outputs=out, name="MoE_CIFAR10")
model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR),
              loss="categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
print(model.summary())

# ----------------------------
# 6. Training
# ----------------------------
model.fit(x_train, y_train,
          validation_split=0.1,
          batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
          epochs=EPOCHS, verbose=2)

# ----------------------------
# 7. Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
# Use Case 1: Single image prediction
sample_img: np.ndarray = x_test[0:1]  # type: np.ndarray
pred_probs: np.ndarray = model.predict(sample_img)  # type: np.ndarray
print("Example 1 - True label:", np.argmax(y_test[0]), "Predicted:", np.argmax(pred_probs))

# Use Case 2: Batch inference and gate weights
sample_imgs: np.ndarray = x_test[10:20]
gate_weights: np.ndarray = gate.predict(sample_imgs)
batch_preds: np.ndarray = model.predict(sample_imgs)
print("Example 2 - Gate weights shape:", gate_weights.shape)
print("Example 2 - Pred labels:", np.argmax(batch_preds, axis=1))

# ----------------------------
# 8. Save Model
# ----------------------------
model.save(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, "moe_cifar10_model.h5"))

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE) architecture with dynamic gating.
  • Expert specialization: multiple CNN branches learn distinct feature subsets.
  • Gating network: lightweight CNN routes inputs to experts.
  • Applications: conditional computation, model sparsity, adaptive inference.

This MoE CNN pushes Keras into conditional routing and dynamic ensemble learning—ideal for large models requiring efficiency and specialization. Continuous extensions: incorporate sparsity, expert pruning, conditional computation on mobile devices.🚀🔥
